summary.note: New vault source, with key expiry and the hourly budget. Compiled bytecode on a local fork against the real router. Not a mainnet run and not an audit. Reentrancy needs a hostile router, so it is covered in the Foundry suite, not here.
summary.drainedMeans: Tokens that left the vault in one case, not value lost. The swap proceeds stay in the vault as USDT. See sandwich for value lost.
